subject: Report: Biden White House Drove DOJ Targeting Of Parents Who Protested CRT, Covid Mandates
posts:
New DOJ reports expose how the Biden White House pushed federal agencies to target parents protesting school board policies.
Evidence: DOJ disclosures, NSBA letters, Garland memo
#Aletheia #USPol

Proponents claimed federal involvement merely protected public school officials from genuine domestic terror threats during heated public meetings.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Internal documents prove the administration weaponized federal law enforcement to suppress dissent and harass concerned parents expressing political views.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.85, -0.9) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
A politically driven Department of Justice manufactured a crisis to target dissenting citizens, subverting federal power for partisan objectives.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 18.5, z: 4)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- White House Directive: FAIL (-0.88, -0.9) — Weaponized DOJ against political dissidents.
- Media Framing: COND (-0.6, -0.5) — Omitted core administrative pressure.
A newly released Justice Department report confirms senior Biden officials drove the creation of the infamous Garland Memo to investigate school board critics.

The Poison:
Using federal investigative powers to silence peaceful citizens creates an authoritarian chilling effect on core First Amendment rights.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (protecting school meetings) with WHO (targeting ordinary parents as threats), executing a classic administrative bait-and-switch.

Social Physics Analysis:
The administration ran a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using an industry lobbyist letter as a manufactured pretext to deploy federal law enforcement against political critics while projecting extremism labels onto parents.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Power extraction under false pretexts collapses institutional trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: Federal power was leveraged to investigate citizens speaking out at local school board meetings.

The Unavoidable Lie: The Department of Justice acted solely to protect public officials from genuine domestic terror threats.

Alethekanon:
Institutional power is easily subverted when partisan actors manufacture external threats to justify suppressing domestic political dissent.🌐

Awwthekanon:
It is deeply painful to watch mothers and fathers who only want a voice in their children's education get treated as enemies of the state by the very leaders sworn to protect them.

Brothekanon:
Using the FBI to harass parents for speaking at school board meetings is wild overreach. No administration should weaponize federal cops against regular citizens like that.

Spirithekanon:
"Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, who write misfortune, which they have prescribed." Isaiah 10:1-2 FAIL
When leaders twist laws to oppress the vulnerable, they invite decay upon the entire civic order.
